Add age variables and drop sparse samples from a cellNexus query.

Source: R/annotate_cell_nexus.R
annotate_cell_nexus.Rd

Intended usage, after a get_metadata() query:

Usage

annotate_cell_nexus(
  x,
  min_cells_per_sample = 50L,
  tissue_groups = "respiratory system"
)

Arguments

x

A metadata table from get_metadata(), or a data frame with the same columns.

min_cells_per_sample

Samples with fewer cells than this are dropped. Every cell of every retained sample is kept.

tissue_groups

Tissue-group label. Used only when x has a tissue_groups column. NULL skips the filter.

Value

A data frame with one row per cell.

Details

obs_lung <- get_metadata() |>
  keep_quality_cells() |>
  dplyr::filter(dataset_id %in% respiratory_dataset_ids()) |>
  annotate_cell_nexus(min_cells_per_sample = 50)

Adds age_years, age_binary (donors older than 50 years), age_bin (20-49 / 50-79), and a sample-scaled age_years_scaled_centered. Rewrites dataset_id with underscores so the identifier can be used in a model formula. Rows are returned in a fixed order, so a seeded subsample is reproducible. When the metadata still contains tissue_groups, rows are limited to tissue_groups. Current cellNexus metadata omits that column; the caller then defines tissue by dataset_id.
